note: The surface-class manifest (S05 P5, design E2). Classifies every exports-map entry except the mechanical ./package.json. Ships in the tarball beside README.md; enforced by script/check-sdk-surface-labels.mjs. frozen entries carry no in-source marker by design: their classification lives here alone so the frozen sources stay untouched.

..reason: The S02 Host port contract barrel — every port role reachable from one entry; check-port-boundary.mjs pins its signature directly.

./host.reason: NavigationHost and the Host-facing port surface (editor-host.ts travels with ports — P0's load-bearing ownership finding); S02 contract.

./in-memory.reason: The in-memory reference implementation of the frozen port contract (S02); its signatures are the contract's.

./in-memory/host.reason: Reference host wiring over the in-memory ports — part of the S02 reference surface.

./conformance.reason: The port conformance suite — the executable form of the S02 contract; its cases are contract truth, so additive-only.

./conformance/requirements.reason: P3's requirement-index legibility layer over the frozen suite — test infrastructure that may be reorganized as suites evolve, without touching the contract it indexes.

./export-jobs.reason: S08 pre-work: the job lifecycle (identity, phases, progress, cancellation, best-effort recovery) the frozen ExportProvider promise shape cannot carry — declared additive and experimental so S08 can ratify, revise or remove it without a frozen-surface revision.
